theme.description: Authority, clarity, and function-first tailored for an enterprise HR platform.

rules: Mobile-first grids defaulting to grid-cols-1, scaling to md:grid-cols-3 or lg:grid-cols-4 for KPI cards
Generous internal padding in containers: use p-6 or p-8 inside cards with borders
Use #F5F5F5 for application shells (like sidebar or main wrapper bg) and #FFFFFF for content panels
Never center-align data-heavy views. Left-align text and tables for scanability.
Cardless or subtle borders: max rounded-md (6px-8px radius). Flat aesthetic.

structure.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, bg-[#F5F5F5] or bg-white with border-r border-gray-200. Contains 7 main modules with Lucide icons.
structure.topbar: Sticky top, h-16, bg-white border-b border-gray-200. Contains User Profile, Notifications (with badge counter), and Global Search.
structure.content_area: bg-[#F5F5F5] p-6 lg:p-8 min-h-screen flex flex-col gap-6

shadcn_rules: Override default borders to 1px solid #E5E7EB, avoiding heavy box-shadows on resting states.
Buttons: rounded-md. Primary CTA bg-[#00C853] text-white hover:bg-[#00A844]. Standard action bg-[#003D7A] text-white hover:bg-[#002B59].
Tables: Left-aligned, no alternating row colors (too noisy), use border-b border-gray-100.
Inputs/Forms: Flat inputs with 1px border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0066CC]

custom_patterns.kpi_card: bg-white p-6 border border-gray-100 rounded-md shadow-sm. Large metric text-3xl font-bold text-[#003D7A]. Accent icon in #00C853.
custom_patterns.status_chip: Inline flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium. Use color semantic mapping (e.g. green for Contratado, yellow for En revisión).
custom_patterns.kanban_column: w-80 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-4 bg-[#F5F5F5] p-4 rounded-md h-[calc(100vh-200px)] overflow-y-auto
custom_patterns.kanban_card: bg-white p-4 border border-gray-200 rounded-md shadow-sm cursor-grab hover:shadow-md hover:border-[#0066CC] transition-all
custom_patterns.security_badge: Fixed element in sidebar footer or login screen showing Lucide Lock icon: 'Secured by AES-256 Encryption'. Font text-xs text-[#666666].

login.layout: Split screen. Left: Modern corporate office image (overlay with #003D7A/40). Right: Login form in white panel.
login.features: Email/Password fields, Google Auth button, AES-256 Security badge below submit CTA. Submit CTA is #00C853.

dashboard.layout: Grid heavy. 4-column KPI row. 2-column wide layout for Charts (Funnel) and Alerts list.

colaboradores.layout: Data table view. Advanced filters at top. 'Cost View' toggle for financial perspective.
colaboradores.interactions: Clicking a row opens a right-side Drawer (Sheet component) with full Colaborador profile detail.

candidatos.interactions: Drag and drop cards. Click card opens modal with CV/Documentos.

vacantes.layout: Tabs to switch between 'List View' and 'Kanban View' by status.

entrevistas.layout: Calendar Agenda View (main) + List View (sidebar). Includes Google Meet link buttons (#0066CC text).

documentos.layout: Digital file explorer style (Expediente digital). Includes 'Share Public Form Link' button with copy to clipboard functionality.

contratos.layout: Generator wizard layout + PDF Preview pane (2-column layout). List view with renewal alerts.

organigrama.layout: Interactive tree/node map. Editable drag-and-drop nodes using custom SVG or canvas-based flow UI (like React Flow if available, else CSS boxes).

testing.required_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='sidebar-candidatos-link')

motion.rules: Minimalist micro-interactions. Use 0.2s ease transitions for hover states. Staggered list entrances for table rows.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and links must explicitly shift text/bg color. Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and gain shadow-md.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Default size 20px for nav, 16px for buttons, 24px for KPI headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL text is in Spanish.
Do NOT use TypeScript files (.tsx). ONLY use JavaScript (.js or .jsx).
Enforce the exact color hex codes provided in the user constraints.
Place the AES-256 security badge in the Login form and Sidebar bottom.
Kanban dragging logic should be mockable via state if a library is not provided.
The primary action button must ALWAYS be Verde Dinámico (#00C853), standard actions Azul Profundo (#003D7A).
